blocks.text:
There are two ways to create a Button. You can specify a label
string in the `Gtk::Button` constructor,
or set it later with set_label().
blocks.zh: 可以通过两种方式来创建按钮，你可以在 Gtk::Button 构造函数中指定标签字符串，或者以后调用 set_label() 来指定标签。

blocks.text:
`Gtk::Button` is also
a container so you could put any other widget, such as a
`Gtk::Image` into it.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Button 同时也是一个容器，因此你可以在其中放任何其它的部件，比如放一个 Gtk::Image 在里面。

blocks.text:
The `Gtk::Button` widget has the `clicked` signal
which is emitted when the button is pressed and released.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Button部件具有clicked信号，当按下或释放按钮时将会发出该信号。

blocks.zh: 这个示例创建了一个有图片和文字标签的按钮。
